title: 刘俊贝：AI基建拉动铜等资源，中国估值洼地机会
speaker: Junbelio

segments.en: Oh, absolutely. Look, I'm always the proponent of the Australian market. So if I'm the resource angle, so for every data center that goes in, you have to have all these commodity precious metals, such as the coppers and the like. Australia is the market that has the biggest, you know, copper producer in the world.
segments.zh: 我一直看好澳大利亚市场。从资源角度看，每个数据中心都需要铜等贵金属。澳大利亚拥有全球最大的铜生产商。

segments.en: And then the whole long chain of upcoming emerging producer in that space. And remember, copper as a commodity, it's actually very difficult now to get approval from approval to get final, you know, digging out of the ground. It takes 18 years now. That's why you see larger miners around the world are buying existing assets. So it is something that, you know, we see supply continue to become constrained and demand is ever increasing for that space.
segments.zh: 还有整个新兴生产商链条。铜矿从审批到开采现在需要18年，所以全球大型矿商在收购现有资产。供应持续受限，需求不断增长。

segments.en: So that's a really interesting angle. But aside from commodity, so you know, we've seen the whole area. So there's your energy, your utility, your pipelines, electrification companies, your circuit board. So memory obviously goes into that space. So there's a whole long chain of, you know, sort of businesses that go to that AI built out infrastructure that we've seen that investors now taking more interest in.
segments.zh: 这个角度很有趣。除了大宗商品，还有能源、公用事业、管道、电气化公司、电路板、存储等。整个AI基础设施产业链，投资者兴趣正在增加。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, we talk about the under-owned, unloved sort of markets, right? Yeah, I mean, how much does Australia, you think, deserve to have now in this sort of like rotation, right? And I guess I asked the same question about China as well, just given what we've been seeing in eight shares. Yeah, absolutely. So I think both China and Australia play a really important role. China, especially, especially the Asia, I think it does offer a lot of exposure to their AI models.
segments.zh: 我们谈到被低配、被忽视的市场。澳大利亚和内地市场都值得关注。内地市场在亚洲尤其重要，提供了很多AI模型相关敞口。

segments.en: So, you know, and the in terms of valuation differential is enormous. I do see that is a, you know, self-contained market where there's a lot of activity you want to be invested in that space. And it's an appreciated compared to the markets like Korea, where we know there's still strong earnings momentum. But I think, you know, the next outperformer will be the likes of China.
segments.zh: 估值差异巨大。内地市场自成一体，活动很多，相比韩国等市场仍被低估。我认为下一个表现优异的市场将是内地市场。
